12724|39b67c2e.name: Pixel
12724|39b67c2e.text: This forest can be confusing! Be careful out there.

12737|aa838c4f.name: Mastok Wrilehiss
12737|aa838c4f.text:
If you want to know about the comings and goings of caravans and merchants here in Splintertree Post, then I am fortunately the orc you are looking for.  Unfortunately for you though, I don't like people.

If you want something, make it quick.

12757|9b4e17a6.name: Karang Amakkar
12757|9b4e17a6.text: Greeting $c - welcome to the front lines in our conquest of Ashenvale!  If you are looking for something to do, then you've come to the right place.  I'm always looking for able-bodied individuals to help bring glory to the Horde!

3043|4711dbab.name: Ker Ragetotem
3043|4711dbab.text: No matter how much one learns, there is always more to know.

3354|08830bac.name: Sorek
3354|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

3354|640f312b.name: Sorek
3354|640f312b.text: Are you here for training?  Or are you just here to waste a $c's time.

4593|ed01dd60.name: Christoph Walker
4593|ed01dd60.text: The $c's role is one of protection.  Just as we protect our compatriots in battle, we must also protect the interests of the Forsaken.

4595|08830bac.name: Baltus Fowler
4595|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

4595|ed01dd60.name: Baltus Fowler
4595|ed01dd60.text: The $c's role is one of protection.  Just as we protect our compatriots in battle, we must also protect the interests of the Forsaken.

4604|3a39b135.name: Abigail Sawyer
4604|3a39b135.text: Words are like arrows. Once loosed, you cannot call them back.

9087|e4fd33dd.name: Bashana Runetotem
9087|e4fd33dd.text: Greetings, noble $c.  This humble servant of the Cenarion Circle wishes blessings and bounties be given unto you and yours.

1013-complete.name: Keeper Bel'dugur
1013-complete.text:
Very good.  This book will add nicely to my collections of the workings of Ur.  His knowledge was great, but his conscience held him from true power.  And so when the Scourge came and his strength was tested, it failed.

We of the Forsaken cannot afford such weakness, if we are to survive...

...If we are to conquer.
1013-complete.title: The Book of Ur

1014-complete.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
1014-complete.text: Silverpine Forest is finally free from the vice of that wretch Arugal. You have done the Dark Lady a great service, $N. Your tenacity shall be rewarded.
1014-complete.title: Arugal Must Die

1049-accept.name: Sage Truthseeker
1049-accept.text:
The Earthen Ring had pure intentions towards our plagued brethren. But who is to know the motivations of those whispering in the ears of the Elder Council?

The Forsaken whom we have allied with have a history wrought with deceit. Too hasty was our pact. Perhaps Cairne would have been wise to heed the warnings from Orgrimmar.

Deep within the Scarlet Monastery lies the Compendium of the Fallen, guarded by crazed human zealots. Their method is forged from insanity but their research might prove useful.
1049-accept.title: Compendium of the Fallen

1063-complete.name: Magatha Grimtotem
1063-complete.text: I bid you greetings.  You are here seeking counsel?
1063-complete.title: The Elder Crone

1064-accept.name: Magatha Grimtotem
1064-accept.text:
The $r have a bond with the land, and it pains me to hear of Stonetalon's plight.  But I fear that to heal the land, we must first remove the disease upon it.

Is it not fortunate, then, that the Forsaken are allied with us?  They know much of disease.  I believe they can aid us, and by doing so they will strengthen the trust between our people.

Speak with Apothecary Zamah.  She is a scholar and an emissary of the Forsaken.  You will find her in the Pools of Vision below the Spirit Rise.
1064-accept.title: Forsaken Aid

1064-complete.name: Apothecary Zamah
1064-complete.text:
Magatha sent word of your coming, $N.  Although my heart beats no longer, I still feel sorrow for the spirits of Stonetalon.

The Forsaken are eager to offer what help we can.
1064-complete.title: Forsaken Aid

1065-accept.name: Apothecary Zamah
1065-accept.text:
To rid Stonetalon of the Venture Company, we must take extreme measures.  Extreme, but without bloodshed.

A colleague of mine may have just the tool we need.  His name is Lydon; he dwells in the town of Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills, in the distant land of Lordaeron.

To reach Hillsbrad, travel by zeppelin to our capital, the Undercity.  Then go north to Tirisfal Glades, southwest to Silverpine, and south to Hillsbrad.

Seek Lydon and bring him this note.  It details our needs to him.
1065-accept.title: Journey to Tarren Mill

1065-complete.name: Apothecary Lydon
1065-complete.text:
A note from Zamah?  Her needs must be great to send word from so far.  Let us see what she says...

Ah, splendid!  I know exactly what to do!
1065-complete.title: Journey to Tarren Mill

1065-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
1065-progress.text: Ah, are you here with my new test subjects?
1065-progress.title: Journey to Tarren Mill

1066-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
1066-accept.text:
I will create a toxin to bleed the violence from the Venture Company, rendering them weak and docile.  That should fix the Horde's problem in Stonetalon, yes?

But to create the toxin, I will need the blood of innocents, a difficult ingredient to obtain.

Fortunately the Syndicate, a group of human brigands in this area, employ shadow mages... and those mages collect innocent blood for their own, unsavory purposes.

You can find the Syndicate shadow mages in Durnholde Keep to the southeast.
1066-accept.title: Blood of Innocents

1066-complete.name: Apothecary Lydon
1066-complete.text:
Very good!  I trust the Syndicate gave you little trouble?

As I mentioned, the blood of innocents is not an easy thing to obtain.  We are lucky the Syndicate shadow mages did the difficult work for us.

Now hold a moment while I create my concoction...
1066-complete.title: Blood of Innocents

1066-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
1066-progress.text: Did you find the Syndicate Shadow Mages, and collect from them the blood?
1066-progress.title: Blood of Innocents

1067-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
1067-accept.text:
Here is the toxin.  If you use it against the Venture Company it should produce favorable, perhaps even contagious, results.  I must say, it is quite exciting to see my work applied in the field!

But before using it, take it to Apothecary Zamah.  She must create a delivery method for the toxin to maximize its effect.
1067-accept.title: Return to Thunder Bluff

1067-complete.name: Apothecary Zamah
1067-complete.text: A toxin from Apothecary Lydon?  Very good.  If I know Lydon, then this toxin will be quite effective against the Venture Company...
1067-complete.title: Return to Thunder Bluff

1067-progress.name: Apothecary Zamah
1067-progress.text: You have returned, $N.  Do you bring aid from Apothecary Lydon?
1067-progress.title: Return to Thunder Bluff

1068-accept.name: Seereth Stonebreak
1068-accept.text:
There is a relation to the spiritual magic of shamans and the natural magic of druids.  This is why we shamans can hear the plea of the spirits of Stonetalon.  Many of their whisperings are lost to me, but one message, one vision, is clear...

I saw a vision of two man-shaped machines in Windshear Crag, northwest of Greatwood Vale, felling trees with impossible speed.  These metal beasts must be stopped!

In my vision, the machines were marked with strange symbols:

XT:4 and XT:9.
1068-accept.title: Shredding Machines

1068-complete.name: Seereth Stonebreak
1068-complete.text:
The destruction of the machines XT:4 and XT:9 have soothed many of the spirits of Stonetalon, $N.  With their loss, let us hope the Venture Company will remove itself from these mountains.

For if they do not, then I fear the atrocities this place has suffered will pale to what lies ahead.
1068-complete.title: Shredding Machines

1086-accept.name: Apothecary Zamah
1086-accept.text:
The toxin is ready.  All that remains is its delivery.  You, $N, must make that delivery.

The Venture Company must have a means of sending messages and light cargo between its headquarters and its operations in Stonetalon.  It is likely a small sky port -- not big enough for a zeppelin, but perhaps for a flying machine.  You must search the areas in Stonetalon under control of the Venture Company and find this sky port, if it exists.  If you find it, then place the toxin there.

Place it, and run.
1086-accept.title: The Flying Machine Airport

1086-complete.name: Apothecary Zamah
1086-complete.text:
You found the port?  Well done, $N!  I am sure the goblins were quite surprised from your delivery!  Let us hope that toxin finds its way to their headquarters.

You have served your people well, and I advise you to ignore any guilt you might harbor for poisoning the Venture Company.  They are deserving of far worse.

And if there is one mote of wisdom the Forsaken might teach its allies, it is this:

Do not shy from dark paths... if those paths lead to victory.
1086-complete.title: The Flying Machine Airport

1087-complete.name: Braelyn Firehand
1087-complete.text:
Already I can feel it... yes... power so sweet... the rushing flood. The kaldorei are foolish to spurn the gifts of this world, to reject the coursing of magic as it flows singing through your veins.

What a pale mockery life is without its burning embrace!
1087-complete.title: Cenarius' Legacy

1088-accept.name: Braelyn Firehand
1088-accept.text:
They thought that they could halt the flow of magic. They were mistaken. They thought that they could hide Ordanus, but I will have his head!

Magic grants me true sight. Yes... there he is. A crossroads... At the top of a great tree in Ashenvale Forest. A name... Raynewood. One of the eldest sons of the forest god. They spirited him away from the peak before I could find him, but his time runs short.

Bring it to me and I will share with you a mighty gift.
1088-accept.title: Ordanus

1088-complete.name: Braelyn Firehand
1088-complete.text:
I knew Ordanus once, long ago. He had the arrogance of his kind, holding himself above even the Highborne.

His head does not rise so high now, does it, $N?

I promised you a reward, and you shall have it. Attend to me.
1088-complete.title: Ordanus

1088-progress.name: Braelyn Firehand
1088-progress.text: When my master bade me to the peak of Stonetalon, I expected that all I would need was to lay waste to the night elves that crawled the sacred ruins of our ancient temple of Azshara, their touch despoiling its sanctity... but Ordanus had slipped my grasp.
1088-progress.title: Ordanus

1089-accept.name: Braelyn Firehand
1089-accept.text:
The druids built the Talon Den on Stonetalon Peak, where they keep many powerful items.

They devised a complex scheme to keep them from falling into the wrong hands.

Luckily, I managed to... extract some details from one of them.

Hidden in a small lantern at the entrance of the Den, you will find the Gatekeeper's Key--with it you will be able to open caches around the Den. The items from these caches will allow you to open their hoard, located in one of the central areas.
1089-accept.title: The Den

1089-complete.name: Unknown
1089-complete.text: As the three keys are slid into their matching openings, in the middle of the glowing light a number of items appear.
1089-complete.title: The Den

1089-progress.name: Unknown
1089-progress.text: Three keyholes are carved into the stone.
1089-progress.title: The Den

1095-complete.name: Ziz Fizziks
1095-complete.text:
Eliminate Gerenzo? Now there is a prospect that I have no objections to.

Gnomes are bad enough as it is, but what I learned about Gerenzo only makes it worse. Apparently, he was one of the head engineers in Gnomeregan, where he was working on their secret project--we could never infiltrate Dun Morogh well enough to find out specific details. It was a failure. Our reports say that whatever it was literally exploded in their faces.
1095-complete.title: Further Instructions

1096-accept.name: Ziz Fizziks
1096-accept.text:
I met Gerenzo once, but let me tell you, he's not easy on the eyes. His flesh looks like it's rotting away, and he's grafted metal and gears onto his body, replaced some of his limbs with mechanical ones.

Northeast of here, far above Cragpool Lake, up near the water wheel is where Gerenzo watches over the entire site. There's no way I could fight my way up there, not to mention take on Gerenzo... But you look like you might be able to make it.

If you kill him for me, I'll make it worth your while!
1096-accept.title: Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle

1096-complete.name: Ziz Fizziks
1096-complete.text:
Look at that thing... it'd take a gnome to come up with something like that. I can't understand why you'd cut off an arm, and replace it with that, when you could just keep both arms and add a third!

Gnomes, I tell you...

At least Gerenzo's out of commission. Hopefully that'll be enough proof, and Sputtervalve will assign me to one of the Tinkers' Union workshops in Gadgetzan or maybe even Undermine.
1096-complete.title: Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle

1096-progress.name: Ziz Fizziks
1096-progress.text: Sputtervalve will want some sort of proof that Gerenzo's dead. I think his mechanical arm will probably do.
1096-progress.title: Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle

1102-accept.name: Auld Stonespire
1102-accept.text:
Cairne is a noble leader for uniting our people here on Thunder Bluff.

But I cannot forgive those who drove us from our ancestral lands as easily as some. My people inhabited the southern Barrens for decades. The land was holy to us. But we were driven off by numerous foes.

A vengeful fate awaits the crone, Charlga Razorflank, who musters a foul army from within Razorfen Kraul.

Bring me Razorflank's heart and I can die in peace, $N.
1102-accept.title: A Vengeful Fate

1109-accept.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
1109-accept.text:
As you can see, $N, we're up to some very.... interesting experiments at the Royal Apothecary Society.

As the Master here, it is my job to oversee the most ambitious of our alchemical attempts. So much work and so little time!

You look well traveled for a $c. Perhaps you can aid me.

I'm in need of a rare substance. It's foul material; it comes from a rare species of bats only found in the muck-hole known as Razorfen Kraul. Bring to me the guano from the Kraul Bats so we can begin our work...
1109-accept.title: Going, Going, Guano!

1164-accept.name: Genavie Callow
1164-accept.text:
The harlot! The swine! Kenata still lives; her family healthy and prospering while I suffer. Forsaken indeed!

My family is gone, taken by the plague. Our estate also forfeit; looted and burned during the war. And after all that, her and her lousy children had the audacity to steal the only precious belongings I had left.

I don't care about the things they stole any more. What I want now are their heads!

Kill them for me! Go to the Dabyrie Farmstead in Arathi, northeast of Refuge Point.
1164-accept.title: To Steal From Thieves

1195-complete.name: Zangen Stonehoof
1195-complete.text: Very good. This should fill Rau's request just fine. Could you deliver this to him? You might enjoy spending some time out in the Needles.
1195-complete.title: The Sacred Flame

1195-progress.name: Zangen Stonehoof
1195-progress.text: Once we have the filled phial, we can send it along to my associate, Rau, in the Thousand Needles. He was the one who requested the phial of water, so he'll better know how we can make use of it.
1195-progress.title: The Sacred Flame

1196-accept.name: Zangen Stonehoof
1196-accept.text:
Bring the filled phial to Rau Cliffrunner at the Freewind Post in southeastern Thousand Needles. You can get to the Thousand Needles by taking the Great Lift at the southern edge of the Barrens.

I wouldn't be surprised if you can help us out further.
1196-accept.title: The Sacred Flame

1486-progress.name: Nalpak
1486-progress.text: I am very interested in examining the hides from the deviate creatures who have infested these caves. Have you had any luck in collecting some, $c?
1486-progress.title: Deviate Hides

1718-accept.name: Baltus Fowler
1718-accept.text:
Your renown as a $c grows, $N.  Now it is time to pit yourself against your peers and see where you stand.

There is an island off the coast of the Barrens, south of Ratchet.  It is called Fray Island and it is a place where warriors meet.

Meet, and fight.

Speak with the chief $c of Fray Island, Klannoc Macleod.  If he finds you worthy, then Klannoc will lead you further down the $c's path.

To reach Fray Island, search for the sand bar shallows along the Merchant Coast.
1718-accept.title: The Islander

1918-accept.name: Unknown
1918-accept.text:
The slain elemental has produced an intensely glowing globe of water.  The contents of the globe are, at best, disgusting.  It would be safe to assume that whatever has befouled the water of Mystral Lake is most likely present in the water of the globe.

It's not exactly common knowledge who might be interested in such a find; perhaps the person who originally sent you out to the lake, Mastok Wrilehiss at Splintertree Post, might have an idea.
1918-accept.title: The Befouled Element

1918-complete.name: Mastok Wrilehiss
1918-complete.text:
You find a nasty ball of water and decide to bring it to me?  Who am I, the Earthen Ring or something?

Actually, that does give me an idea... perhaps you do need the Earthen Ring for this.  I mean, if it helps clear up the situation at the lake for good, then I'm all for it.

You know who the Earthen Ring are, $N?
1918-complete.title: The Befouled Element

216-accept.name: Karang Amakkar
216-accept.text:
The Thistlefur furbolgs are threatening our expansion!  Thistlefur Village to our east blocks the way between us here and the Splintertree Post.  It's a path that would circumvent the village of Astranaar; without it, we give the Alliance an extra expansion path.

$N, we must not allow... an expansion path gap!

Proceed to Thistlefur Village and thin out the furbolgs.  You will be given compensation for this task, but more importantly you will be doing your duty for the Horde!
216-accept.title: Between a Rock and a Thistlefur

216-complete.name: Karang Amakkar
216-complete.text:
Well done $c, well done!  I will continue to send forces to thin out the furbolg, but I can at least count on a different path that will be free of Alliance entanglements.  The Horde conquest of Ashenvale is now in full swing!

You've earned your pay this day, hero.  I salute you!
216-complete.title: Between a Rock and a Thistlefur

25-complete.name: Mastok Wrilehiss
25-complete.text:
Yeah, I heard that someone tore up the lake out there like a dust devil through the Barrens.  From the sound of it too, we might be able to set up a possible observation area out there to keep an eye on our Alliance friends.  Well, that is if we can keep it on the down low...

Looks like you ended up being quite useful after all; the transports between here and Stonetalon should have an easier time of it.  Take this - you've earned it.
25-complete.title: Stonetalon Standstill

2841-accept.name: Nogg
2841-accept.text:
Gnome technology - two years ago its most common use was as a punch line. Times certainly have changed. Now they've got a new rig built that's better than all our shredder models combined. I need the blueprints, $N!

Unfortunately, the plans are locked away in a safe near Mekgineer Thermaplugg. To make matters worse, the combination to the safe is only known by Mekgineer Thermaplugg.

Do whatever you have to do to get that combination, $N. Then crack open that safe and bring back those blueprints!
2841-accept.title: Rig Wars

3369-progress.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
3369-progress.text: May I help you with something?
3369-progress.title: In Nightmares

3921-complete.name: Wenikee Boltbucket
3921-complete.text:
Oh, what's this?  A samophlange, you say?  What's a samophlange??

Ah... but look at the way it moves when you handle it.  And there's the sound of intricate gears inside.  Oh my!  I want to fix it and see what it does, don't you??
3921-complete.title: Wenikee Boltbucket

3921-progress.name: Wenikee Boltbucket
3921-progress.text: I'm very busy with my work, $c.  Unless you have something for me, it'd be best if you moved along...
3921-progress.title: Wenikee Boltbucket

3922-accept.name: Wenikee Boltbucket
3922-accept.text:
I want to fix this samophlange, but to do that I'm going to need some supplies.  I ran out of seventeen-point-five gauge nugget slugs and I'm going to need a bunch of those for the work ahead.

The closest place to get them is the Sludge Fen to the east.  The Venture Company usually keeps them in their tool buckets.  Go to the Sludge Fen and look in the tool buckets you find there, then return to me when you've gathered enough nugget slugs.
3922-accept.title: Nugget Slugs

496-complete.name: Apothecary Lydon
496-complete.text: These specimens are perfect.  Well, $N, you have managed to bring me the slightest hint of joy on yet another miserable day.  Your efforts are appreciated.
496-complete.title: Elixir of Suffering

496-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
496-progress.text: I see you are back.  I hope you were able to gather the agents I need.  Another deathless day will put me in such a gloomy mood.
496-progress.title: Elixir of Suffering

498-accept.name: Krusk
498-accept.text:
Me and some other warriors were sent by the Warchief to retrieve an object from Durnholde and to investigate this so-called Syndicate.

We went to Durnholde to take a look around, but we were taken by surprise by a large number of the humans. We fought bravely, but their sheer numbers were enough to defeat us. They took a few of us captive, but I was able to escape.

Durnholde is just southeast of here, across the river. Drull and Tog'thar are being held there, you must go and rescue them.
498-accept.title: The Rescue

498-complete.name: Krusk
498-complete.text:
So the humans thought to turn our warriors into slaves, did they? We'll show them!

It would seem that they have taken Gol'dir, our leader, to another location. We must find him and rescue him. But we currently have no clue where he is...

When we have a lead, I will be sure to tell you, $N.
498-complete.title: The Rescue

499-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
499-accept.text:
It will take but a moment for me to mix these components into what I have deemed an Elixir of Suffering.

There we go!  Ah, nothing brightens a gloomy day in these miserable foothills like bringing a little suffering into the world.

Let us see if our little potion has achieved its desired effect.

Give my assistant Umpi a taste of what the Dark Lady has planned for both humans and Scourge alike.
499-accept.title: Elixir of Suffering

501-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
501-accept.text:
Oh, $N. . .the flowers are blooming in Hillsbrad and the air is so fresh and brisk.  I can't help but to wallow in the misery of it all.  I look out my grimy window and long for the day when our New Plague brings this world the death it deserves.

As much as I would love to sit and brood all day, my duty to the Dark Lady calls.  Help me, would you?  My research leads me to believe I can make the most splendid death-brew with the blood of a Mountain Lion.  Bring some to me and we'll have a little fun.
501-accept.title: Elixir of Pain

501-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
501-progress.text: I remember you, $N.  You were going to help me out in concocting my latest elixir.  I'll need that blood before I can bring my own special brand of misery to the inhabitants of Hillsbrad.
501-progress.title: Elixir of Pain

502-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
502-accept.text:
Ah, nothing like the smell of fresh blood in the foothills!

Now we'll mix in a touch of this and a little of that and let the real fun begin!  What I have created with this blood, I like to call an Elixir of Pain.  If my calculations are correct this concoction could be the start of something very beautiful for Lady Sylvanas.  But what we need is a test.

Take this elixir out to the northern farm in Hillsbrad Fields to the southwest.  Let's see how Farmer Ray's little dog Stanley likes this "treat."
502-accept.title: Elixir of Pain

502-complete.name: Stanley
502-complete.text: You pour some of the elixir into your hand and hold it before Stanley's mouth.
502-complete.title: Elixir of Pain

509-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
509-accept.text:
Another day, another elixir to be made. If it were up to me, I'd just let the pathetic humans and Scourge fight it out.  They seem bent on killing each other as is.

Alas, our Dark Lady wants to help speed up the process a tad so why not pass these morbid days by spreading a little death and disease across the land?

Here's the plan, $N: you go out to Nethander Stead, south of Tarren Mill and east of the river and Southshore. Collect for me 6 Mudsnout Blossoms from the field for my next elixir.
509-accept.title: Elixir of Agony

509-complete.name: Apothecary Lydon
509-complete.text: Ah, the horrible reek of Mudsnout Blossoms.  At least those filthy Gnolls are good for something.
509-complete.title: Elixir of Agony

513-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
513-accept.text:
Just when I thought another day was going to pass devoid of any joy, you brought me those marvelous Mudsnout Blossoms.

First I will mix them down into a fine composite.  We'll then need Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity to apply his colloid of decay to it and then we'll be ready for some good fun indeed!

Here, take this Mudsnout Composite and run it off to Master Faranell at once, $N.
513-accept.title: Elixir of Agony

513-complete.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
513-complete.text:
Apothecary Lydon sent you?  Ah, why didn't you say so!

Despite his gloomy disposition, Apothecary Lydon is one of our most dedicated and skilled members.

The good chap sends Mudsnout Composite!  I know what our friend in Hillsbrad is up to now.  And I like the way he thinks.  The Dark Lady would be most impressed with the progress he is making toward the new plague.
513-complete.title: Elixir of Agony

513-progress.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
513-progress.text: Can you not see I am busy, $c?  The Dark Lady insists on a new plague before the Scourge advance from Northrend overwhelms us.  And with the human threat pressing from the south, time becomes my most precious commodity.  This better be important!
513-progress.title: Elixir of Agony

515-accept.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
515-accept.text:
A mudsnout composite?  Absolutely brilliant!  Why didn't I think of that?

Let me contribute my colloid of decay to this devilish brew.

In order to activate the contaminating agents in this mudsnout mixture, Lydon is going to need a strong troll's blood elixir, as well as some daggerspine scales and torn fin eyes from the southern coast of Hillsbrad.  He'll know what to do once you've gathered him all the reagents.  And my, how anxious I am to hear how his experiment goes!
515-accept.title: Elixir of Agony

527-complete.name: High Executor Darthalia
527-complete.text: At ease, $c.  I see you have returned from battle.  My sources tell me you performed well on the Hillsbrad front.
527-complete.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

528-accept.name: High Executor Darthalia
528-accept.text:
Word of the attack on the northern farms has the townsfolk panicked.  Most excellent.

Our Deathstalkers report peasants fleeing to the fields in southern Hillsbrad.  The fools think they can hide in the orchards and escape their doom.

Prove them wrong, $N.  Return to Hillsbrad Fields and seek out the cowering peasants.  Lay waste to them in the name of our Dark Lady.

Dismissed!
528-accept.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

528-complete.name: High Executor Darthalia
528-complete.text: The grip of death is tightening around the town of Hillsbrad.  The battle goes well.
528-complete.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

528-progress.name: High Executor Darthalia
528-progress.text: You have your orders, $c.  Quit dawdling here in Tarren Mill when there is work to be done elsewhere.
528-progress.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

529-accept.name: High Executor Darthalia
529-accept.text:
The humans of Hillsbrad have been putting up unexpected resistance.  The problem appears to be that the townsfolk are being armed by the local blacksmith.  We need to shut down all supply lines.

Your mission will be to execute Blacksmith Verringtan.  Slay his apprentices as well.  While there, bring back a shipment of iron from their stockpile.  The supplies will come in handy when we are done with the conquering of Hillsbrad and begin razing Southshore.
529-accept.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

529-complete.name: High Executor Darthalia
529-complete.text: Mission accomplished, $c.  And carried out quite skillfully, I might add.
529-complete.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

529-progress.name: High Executor Darthalia
529-progress.text: Were you able to carry out your orders, $c?  Did you dispose of Verringtan and his assistants?  And where is that iron shipment?
529-progress.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

532-accept.name: High Executor Darthalia
532-accept.text:
The town of Hillsbrad is in disarray and we believe it will soon fall.  We must, however, persist in our ruthlessness until the human scum are wiped from the foothills for eternity.

Despite their overwhelming losses, the humans rally around their leadership and keep fighting.  We must eliminate their leader, Magistrate Burnside, as well as the town council.  Destroy their revered political document as well, the Hillsbrad Proclamation.  And while you're at it, steal the town registry.
532-accept.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

532-complete.name: High Executor Darthalia
532-complete.text: News of your glories in Hillsbrad traveled fast.  You have done well, $c.
532-complete.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

539-accept.name: High Executor Darthalia
539-accept.text:
The Hillsbrad Town Registry indicates that the Azureload Mine is under Alliance control.  Furthermore, the mine is a prime source of iron ore for the Alliance armories.

Even though we've struck a decisive blow to the town of Hillsbrad, the Alliance still supports and protects the Azureload Mine fervently.

The mine lies due south of Hillsbrad.  Go there and slay the foreman, a human by the name of Bonds.  Kill his miners as well.  That should send a clear message to the Alliance.
539-accept.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

546-accept.name: Deathguard Samsa
546-accept.text:
I hear you were enlisted by Darthalia to wage war on the humans of Hillsbrad.  So jealous I am. . .

While you're off having all the fun -- slaying humans, pillaging the town, terrorizing innocent people -- I am stuck standing guard here in Tarren Mill.

Perhaps you'll take pity on an old Deathguard like myself?  You see I am collecting human skulls.  And you will be fighting humans for quite some time.  Over the course of your long battle, bring me 30 skulls and I will make it worth your while.
546-accept.title: Souvenirs of Death

546-complete.name: Deathguard Samsa
546-complete.text: Precious skulls!  So beautiful!  I owe you as promised, $N!
546-complete.title: Souvenirs of Death

546-progress.name: Deathguard Samsa
546-progress.text:
So the lucky $N returns?  How many humans have you slaughtered today?  Hundreds I do hope!

Have you any skulls for me?
546-progress.title: Souvenirs of Death

547-accept.name: Deathguard Humbert
547-accept.text:
High Executor Darthalia sent me to keep watch of Dun Garok from a distance.  I had set up camp just out of sight.  But when morning came and I had to boil water, I left to gather firewood.

When I returned to camp, I discovered my gear was missing.

Apparently some dwarven scouts from Dun Garok had passed by and made off with it.  I need my sword!  If you can get it back for me I would be so grateful.  So many dwarves there...it will be quite difficult to find the dirty little thief who stole it.
547-accept.title: Humbert's Sword

549-accept.name: Unknown
549-accept.text:
By the authority of Lady Sylvanas, all members of the organization known as the Syndicate are wanted dead. Those brought into custody or taken prisoner will be summarily executed. They are currently known to be amassing in the ruins of Durnholde Keep, to the southeast of Tarren Mill.

A handsome reward is offered to all who bring proof of their deeds to High Executor Darthalia.
549-accept.title: WANTED: Syndicate Personnel

549-complete.name: High Executor Darthalia
549-complete.text: Excellent, $c. At this rate, the Syndicate pest will be rid from the land in no time.
549-complete.title: WANTED: Syndicate Personnel

567-accept.name: Unknown
567-accept.text:
Dangerous!

The following humans of Hillsbrad have been deemed dangerous and are marked for bounty by High Executor Darthalia:

Clerk Horrace Whitesteed.  Wanted for the murder of Deathguard Toma.

Citizen Wilkes.  Wanted for the murder of Apothecary Eli.

Miner Hackett.  Wanted for the murder of Deathstalker Fry.

Farmer Kalaba.  Wanted for the ambush of supplies from the Undercity.

All of these enemies are hiding and will be hard to find.  A reward will be granted upon notice of their death.
567-accept.title: Dangerous!

567-complete.name: High Executor Darthalia
567-complete.text: You are quite the bounty hunter, $c.  Well done.
567-complete.title: Dangerous!

6282-complete.name: Maggran Earthbinder
6282-complete.text: This is most excellent news! Tell me again how you cast fear into the cold hearts of those vile harpies. The Bloodfuries have been dealt a serious blow!
6282-complete.title: Harpies Threaten

6283-accept.name: Maggran Earthbinder
6283-accept.text:
Limiting the number of Bloodfury Harpies will not be enough. The only true cure for their disease would be to slay their leader, Bloodfury Ripper!

She is all but a queen to those filthy creatures. Slay her and their numbers will surely diminish.

Go back into the Charred Vale and you will find her along the western hills. She will not be easy to vanquish, but the reward will be great.
6283-accept.title: Bloodfury Bloodline

6283-complete.name: Maggran Earthbinder
6283-complete.text:
Already I feel the anger leave me. What will I do with my time? Knowing evil moves near my land kept my thoughts moving, though now they are silent. Perhaps this is a good thing... maybe now I can focus on the good, as all $R should.

Please accept this as a reward for your troubles.
6283-complete.title: Bloodfury Bloodline

6283-progress.name: Maggran Earthbinder
6283-progress.text:
Bloodfury Ripper is a nasty creature! You will have success finding her along the western hill line in the Charred Vale.

The bloodfuries will be helpless with out... surely we can vanquish them forever!
6283-progress.title: Bloodfury Bloodline

6301-complete.name: Tammra Windfield
6301-complete.text:
Ah, $N, you have the Gaea seeds. Watch and see how the blessing of the Earthmother can cause even these small kernels of life to bloom and flourish.

<Tammra begins to chant.>
6301-complete.title: Cycle of Rebirth

6301-progress.name: Tammra Windfield
6301-progress.text: The continuous destruction caused by war and those that seek a profit from lumber pains me deeply. To aid the cycle of rebirth and replenish the lands, I need Gaea seeds. Do you have them, $c?
6301-progress.title: Cycle of Rebirth

6381-accept.name: Tammra Windfield
6381-accept.text:
As you have seen, $c, though the land is in pain, the cycle of life is a powerful thing. Now we must do our part help it along. You must plant these seeds at the center of the destruction, to the west, in the Charred Vale. Beware, for harpies and angry fire elementals still plague the scarred land.

$N, take these enchanted Gaea seeds and plant them in fertile mounds of soil. The cycle of life must go on!
6381-accept.title: New Life

6381-complete.name: Tammra Windfield
6381-complete.text:
This is great victory for the land. In time, other things will come to pass: the Venture Co. will pack up their buzz saws and axes, the angry fire spirits will calm, and the harpies will be pushed out by the land.

Only then $N, will Stonetalon be truly at peace.

You have done well $c; take one of these items as thanks for the new life you have created here today.
6381-complete.title: New Life

6381-progress.name: Tammra Windfield
6381-progress.text:
These seeds you plant are strong, resisting corruption, and making a foothold for other life. They will grow and grow, first preventing corruption and healing the scarred land, and then one day, restoring Stonetalon to a lush forest, once again.

Have you planted all of the Gaea seeds?
6381-progress.title: New Life

6393-complete.name: Tsunaman
6393-complete.text: The water spirits within me bubble with the excitement. $N, you have given me a glorious victory to report to the Tribunal of the Tides.
6393-complete.title: Elemental War

6393-progress.name: Tsunaman
6393-progress.text: The Tribunal of the Tides grows impatient. They seek to end this war that has raged across all dimensions for eons. My brethren are anxious to hear news of the glorious victory over the hated fire elementals. Have you the Incendrites that I require?
6393-progress.title: Elemental War

6421-complete.name: Mor'rogal
6421-complete.text:
Ah... Yes! That's it; the Resonite crystals have a trace of Earthen magic. The kobolds must have dug deep uncovering an Earthen.

Legend states that the Earthen are creatures created by the Titans.  They were used to create the land our feet walk on. This most definitely is a threat that cannot be ignored.

<Mor'rogal shakes his head.>

Perhaps I can enchant these ore samples to use against this kobold plot.
6421-complete.title: Boulderslide Ravine

6421-progress.name: Mor'rogal
6421-progress.text: What news have you discovered from Boulderslide Ravine? I recall some legend that deals with Resonite... I just cannot place my hoof on it. Perhaps knowing what lies at the bottom of the cave will illuminate their devious intentions.
6421-progress.title: Boulderslide Ravine

6441-complete.name: Pixel
6441-complete.text:
These are perfect, $N! Thanks for helping me out!

Oh, and this is for your time...
6441-complete.title: Satyr Horns

6441-progress.name: Pixel
6441-progress.text: I hope you can be quick about getting those horns, $N. I'm heading back to Ratchet soon!
6441-progress.title: Satyr Horns

6442-complete.name: Marukai
6442-complete.text: We could use more of your kind around here, $N. Thank you for your help.
6442-complete.title: Naga at the Zoram Strand

6442-progress.name: Marukai
6442-progress.text: The naga increase in numbers, $N. Please complete this task for me.
6442-progress.title: Naga at the Zoram Strand

6461-complete.name: Xen'Zilla
6461-complete.text:
Sweet, mon! Good news, perhaps we will have fewer unwanted dinner guests tonight.

Many thanks, $N.  We are forever in your debt.
6461-complete.title: Blood Feeders

6462-complete.name: Mitsuwa
6462-complete.text:
You found them!  Thank you!  Thank you, $N!  You do not know how great a thing you have done for me.

A troll without his charm is like an orc without his battle scars...

Worthless.
6462-complete.title: Troll Charm

6462-progress.name: Mitsuwa
6462-progress.text: Did you find the charms, $N?  Every moment the furbolgs possess those sacred items, my blood boils with rage!
6462-progress.title: Troll Charm

6481-accept.name: Mor'rogal
6481-accept.text:
You have uncovered a dark threat to the land, $c. The Resonite cask you have found in that cave houses a slumbering Earthen by the name of Goggeroc.

I have changed the mixture of the Resonite crystals that you gathered with my shamanistic powers. Take the enchanted Resonite crystal and smash open the Resonite cask, which houses the Earthen.

When awakened, Goggeroc will be weakened... Slay him, $N!
6481-accept.title: Earthen Arise

6481-complete.name: Mor'rogal
6481-complete.text:
You bear good news, $c! I fear the possibilities of what an Earthen would mean to Kalimdor.

Slaying Goggeroc was a task for no one less than a hero. You have done well; all of Stonetalon and Kalimdor are indebted to you, noble $c.

Accept this as your reward most honored one.
6481-complete.title: Earthen Arise

6481-progress.name: Mor'rogal
6481-progress.text: I fear if we do not dispose of this threat immediately, all of Stonetalon will be lost. The might of an Earthen can not be matched by any means. When awakened, Goggeroc will be weak from his long slumber, this will be the opportunity that you must take advantage of... go now $N!
6481-progress.title: Earthen Arise

6482-accept.name: Ruul Snowhoof
6482-accept.text:
Eh?  Who are you?

$N?  You're no furbolg.  They are cursed!  They thought I was a bear and captured me, and now they starve me!  My strength is failing...

Help me escape, then speak with my sister Yama at the Splintertree Post to the east.

$N! I must escape!
6482-accept.title: Freedom to Ruul

6482-complete.name: Yama Snowhoof
6482-complete.text:
You found my brother!  He was captured by the Thistlefurs?  That is terrible news to hear, for although many Furbolgs are noble creatures, the Thistlefurs are corrupt.

Thank you for rescuing my brother, $N.  I do not want to think of how they treated poor Ruul.  He will likely sleep long after this ordeal...
6482-complete.title: Freedom to Ruul

6504-accept.name: Gurda Ragescar
6504-accept.text:
I just picked up this shredder from Ratchet and I was on my way back to the Warsong Lumber Camp, where I am supposed to be on duty. I was given a manual on how to operate the shredder, but on the trip back, a huge gust of wind blew it from my hands. The pages went everywhere, and all I was left with was the cover.

The pages could be just about anywhere by now, I suppose... but I don't know how to use the shredder without them! Will you find them for me?
6504-accept.title: The Lost Pages

6504-complete.name: Gurda Ragescar
6504-complete.text: Reading isn't my strong point... but now I'll be able to get back to work! Thanks, $N!
6504-complete.title: The Lost Pages

6504-progress.name: Gurda Ragescar
6504-progress.text: I hope you find the pages soon, $N! I really need to get back to work!
6504-progress.title: The Lost Pages

6561-accept.name: Unknown
6561-accept.text:
Strength has left me. Your help is needed!

Long ago this site was a great temple of Elune. But misfortune led to ruin when the corruption of an Old God seeped up from beneath the earth and tainted the sacred Moon Well.

Aku'Mai, servant of the Old God, rose from the waters.

The Twilight's Hammer cultists have allied with the naga to occupy these grounds. The cultists, led by Kelris, sacrifice innocents to Aku'Mai for power.

Slay Kelris and bring his head to Bashana in Thunder Bluff, $N, please.
6561-accept.title: Blackfathom Villainy

6561-complete.name: Bashana Runetotem
6561-complete.text:
Kelris has eluded the Argent Dawn for some time.

For some time they considered him dead or missing.

By ending his reign you have spared the lives of many innocent people, $N.

Earthmother be praised! To sacrifice another to a servant of an Old God for personal gain is beyond disgusting!

You have done a great thing this day. Kelris was a creature of evil and sought to bring the world back to a time of chaos by worshipping such creatures as the Old Gods. Thank you, $N.
6561-complete.title: Blackfathom Villainy

6561-progress.name: Bashana Runetotem
6561-progress.text:
May the Earthmother be with you, $N.

Peace between the earth and all her people should be our goal. She has a grand plan for nature, and we all have a role to play in that plan.
6561-progress.title: Blackfathom Villainy

6563-complete.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6563-complete.text:
Well done, $N. These are the crystals I spoke of. Intriguing...

I can feel the power within them. The spirits of water cling to them. Whatever the naga were going to use these for... well, let us be glad they are no longer in their hands.
6563-complete.title: The Essence of Aku'Mai

6563-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6563-progress.text: How goes your search for the crystals, $N? Have you witnessed the naga harvesting them? I pray to my ancestors we find the reason they are collecting such things.
6563-progress.title: The Essence of Aku'Mai

6564-complete.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6564-complete.text:
This is interesting indeed. I am glad you have brought it to my attention.

Now we have a name for our troubles... Lorgus Jett.
6564-complete.title: Allegiance to the Old Gods

6564-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6564-progress.text: Yes, $N? What is it you need? There is still much I must learn about the crystals the naga are gathering.
6564-progress.title: Allegiance to the Old Gods

6565-accept.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6565-accept.text:
This Twilight's Hammer follower cannot be allowed to complete his plan. The Twilight's Hammer do not understand the spirits of nature. They believe in the Old Gods--creatures of chaos and destruction that were long ago defeated. This Lorgus cannot be allowed to succeed. You must stop him, $N. I cannot do it myself--I am too weak.

Go into Blackfathom Deeps, find him, and kill him. Return to me here at Zoram'gar when it's done.
6565-accept.title: Allegiance to the Old Gods

6565-complete.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6565-complete.text:
Very good!! Thank you, $N. We may not have stopped the Twilight's Hammer completely, but at least you have staved off another of their plans to return the Old Gods to power.

Who knows what other plans they have manifesting, but we can rest easy for now.
6565-complete.title: Allegiance to the Old Gods

6571-complete.name: Locke Okarr
6571-complete.text:
Excellent, $N. You've saved me a lot of work!

But don't think that I'm not grateful!
6571-complete.title: Warsong Supplies

6571-progress.name: Locke Okarr
6571-progress.text: I hope you can come through with the supplies! I'm in big trouble if I don't deliver them soon!
6571-progress.title: Warsong Supplies

6581-complete.name: Pixel
6581-complete.text: This is perfect -- just the thing! Well, here's the shipment.
6581-complete.title: Warsong Saw Blades

6581-progress.name: Pixel
6581-progress.text:
Direct from Ratchet, the Warsong saw blades! Yep, I have them right here.

..But what sort of payment do you have for me? You can't just take them, you know! My time isn't cheap!

What I really need is a good gun to carry with me on my travels. A girl's gotta protect herself, you know? There's a gun I really like that I'm sure an engineer would have no problem making.

So, if you bring me a deadly blunderbuss, I'll give you the saw blade shipment. Do we have a deal?
6581-progress.title: Warsong Saw Blades

6621-accept.name: Karang Amakkar
6621-accept.text:
$N, another tribe of Furbolgs,  the Foulweald, live southeast of Astranaar.  They are not as many as the Thistlefur, but their ferocity poses a future threat.  With a show of force, we can remove that threat.

Take this banner, go to the Foulweald village and place it on their totem mound.  They will try to destroy the banner, but hold your ground until their chief, Murgut, appears to save face for the tribe.  Bring me the totem he carries.

Gather your allies, $N.  This is no task for a single $c.
6621-accept.title: King of the Foulweald

6621-complete.name: Karang Amakkar
6621-complete.text:
Good work, $N.  Issuing that challenge to the Foulwealds and defeating their leader sends them a strong message:

The Horde is not to be trifled with.

I don't believe that tribe will be giving us much trouble for a long time.
6621-complete.title: King of the Foulweald

6621-progress.name: Karang Amakkar
6621-progress.text: Did you defeat Chief Murgut, $N?  Did you retrieve his Foulweald Totem?
6621-progress.title: King of the Foulweald

6641-accept.name: Muglash
6641-accept.text:
Vorsha the Lasher... the fiendish hydra that roams the seas...

She has attacked our outpost, each time unprovoked, laying waste to anything that falls in her path.

But I am ready, $N. I have prepared to best the hydra and end these attacks on Zoram'gar.

The naga honor the wicked nature of this beast with a brazier that remains lit on an island just off the coast. I believe that if we put it out, Vorsha will appear in anger.

We will need help, so be sure to bring some strong allies.
6641-accept.title: Vorsha the Lasher

6641-complete.name: Warsong Runner
6641-complete.text:
I have witnessed many naga attacks since I arrived here. It puts my mind at ease that Vorsha will no longer roam freely.

We are in your debt, $N.
6641-complete.title: Vorsha the Lasher

6921-accept.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6921-accept.text:
The Twilight's Hammer has moved into the Moonshrine Ruins of Blackfathom Deeps.  Their presence can only serve to coerce the elements into working against us.  If left unchecked, this region will be theirs for good.

$N, go into Blackfathom and find the ruin's fathom stone; it should be somewhere close in the water.  In it is a fathom core - a device that when properly read it will relate a history of all elemental activity.  If I have it, I and the Earthen Ring can maybe do something to stop them!
6921-accept.title: Amongst the Ruins

6921-complete.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6921-complete.text:
This is exactly what I need!  A fathom core is an incredible well of information that we will be able to draw much good from.  Whatever the Twilight's Hammer is up to in there - and believe me when I say it is no good - my comrades and I will now uncover.

You've done well here today; the Earthen Ring looks upon you warmly for assisting us.  You've also helped the Horde as a whole, and for that you should be proud.
6921-complete.title: Amongst the Ruins

6921-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6921-progress.text: Have you been successful in locating the fathom core?  Without it we'll have no idea what the Twilight's Hammer is exactly up to down there.
6921-progress.title: Amongst the Ruins

6922-accept.name: Unknown
6922-accept.text:
The defeated water elemental has left behind a strange water globe.  You surmise that the object somehow fed the beast energy.  Inside the globe, a putrid-looking form of water sloshes about.  The globe itself seems impervious to any sort of physical force.

If anyone can make any sense of this item, it would be Je'neu Sancrea of the Earthen Ring.  He is located at the Horde's Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale.
6922-accept.title: Baron Aquanis

6922-complete.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6922-complete.text:
This... this is quite the find, $N.

You acquired this from Baron Aquanis in Blackfathom, you say?  Baron Aquanis has long been thought of as a corrupted elemental power; this globe will prove what exactly had corrupted him.  While it would be no surprise if it turned out to be the Twilight's Hammer, our studies will also show how they did it as well.

You did well in bringing this to me.  Please - take this, along with the Earthen Ring's warmest regards.
6922-complete.title: Baron Aquanis

6922-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6922-progress.text: Ah, hello again $N.  I was just reading the waves the sea, much like I always do.  What brings you to the outpost?
6922-progress.title: Baron Aquanis

6981-progress.name: Falla Sagewind
6981-progress.text: Hello, $r. What can I do for you?
6981-progress.title: The Glowing Shard

7321-accept.name: Sylestamar
7321-accept.text:
Who says that the undead don't know anything about cooking? Take my secret recipe for Turtle Bisque, for example. I've known folks that would come back from the dead just to enjoy a bowl! Heh, heh...

Speaking of which, I haven't been able to make any lately.  I used to head over to Lake Lordamere myself to hunt snapjaws, the nasty things, but I can't pull myself away from my work here.

If you bring me some Turtle Meat from the snapjaws and soothing spices, I'll show you how it's done!
7321-accept.title: Soothing Turtle Bisque

824-accept.name: Mastok Wrilehiss
824-accept.text:
The Earthen Ring is a shamanistic group dedicated to studying and preserving the elements.  They have forgotten more about crazy old gods, ancient legends and lore than most scholars will ever know.

Lucky for you, I know someone in the Earthen Ring here in Ashenvale.  Head over to Zoram'gar Outpost on the coast of the Zoram Strand; show Je'neu Sancrea what you found.  If anyone can figure out that globe's significance, it'd be him.
824-accept.title: Je'neu of the Earthen Ring

824-complete.name: Je'neu Sancrea
824-complete.text:
This globe... it is most disturbing.  Many of the more powerful elementals receive their power and energy through such devices.  To find one like this nearly intact is one thing - to find it so tainted is another.

I will see that this globe is studied properly by the Earthen Ring.  Perhaps we can bring an end to this corruption of the elements.  Please - accept this as a fair exchange for bringing this globe to the attention of the Earthen Ring.
824-complete.title: Je'neu of the Earthen Ring

824-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
824-progress.text:
Ah, hello there.  I spend a great deal of time studying the water - all the elements really - so much so that sometimes I don't even notice people around me.

Is there something I can help you with?
824-progress.title: Je'neu of the Earthen Ring

86576-complete.name: Mor'rogal
86576-complete.text:
Ah, you have brought sunstones that the harpies collect! The harpies love to gather objects that are shiny, but they do not know the true value of the stones. By capturing the dazzling light of the sun, these stones reflect its majesty and allow us to adorn our shrines and homes with tiny motes of light in its honor. The moon, too, illuminates them with its silver beauty at night.

These stones remind us of the connection we have to the lights of the skies.
86576-complete.title: Bloodfury Trinkets

86576-progress.name: Mor'rogal
86576-progress.text: I have important matters to consider, $c. Be quick.
86576-progress.title: Bloodfury Trinkets

875-complete.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
875-complete.text: Excellent work my friend. I think you'll go far within the Horde.
875-complete.title: Harpy Lieutenants

875-progress.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
875-progress.text: Do you have 6 Harpy Lieutenant Rings yet? Justice must be dealt to them for their vicious attacks on the Horde.
875-progress.title: Harpy Lieutenants

876-accept.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
876-accept.text:
You did so well with the lieutenants and underlings that I'd like you to do one last thing for me.

Serena Bloodfeather is the sister of a harpy named Bloodfeather who was slain by Rexxar quite a while ago. Apparently, these attacks on the Horde caravans are revenge for her sister's death.

I need you to slit her throat and bring me back her head. I want to place it on the next caravan we send out... Give those harpies something to think about.
876-accept.title: Serena Bloodfeather

95697-accept.name: Borstan
95697-accept.text:
Zamja tells me we need more homestyle cooking.
If we start selling raptor, she thinks it'll draw in customers who don't usually visit Borstan's Firepit.

Her idea is not so bad. But I want something that rises above the smells of our birth villages. We're in Orgrimmar! Borstan should serve a grand take on their familiar favorites.

A hunter recently came back from the Wetlands with a giant talon from the thicket raptors in the Excavation Sites.

Up for a job?
95697-accept.title: Changing Tastes

95884-accept.name: Unknown
95884-accept.text:
<The scrap of note is mostly illegible. What is still readable, however, are notes about preparations for an offering.

An offering stone is mentioned, as well as a ritual.

Perhaps you can find this offering stone nearby.>
95884-accept.title: The Offering Stone

962-progress.name: Apothecary Zamah
962-progress.text: I am eager to see if you can gather enough Serpentbloom from the Wailing Caverns. I've sent many to do my bidding but none have returned.
962-progress.title: Serpentbloom

96986-accept.name: Melisara
96986-accept.text:
Within the underbelly of the mage city to the north is a traitor to our kind. A necromancer of disturbing talent. He raises an army of undeath right under the Kirin Tor's nose.

I care not for the fate of the mage city, $N, but this grave knight spits in the face of everything we Forsaken stand for. Put an end to him. Show him no one is beyond the reach of the Dark Lady.
96986-accept.title: The Grave Knight

96988-accept.name: Doctor Martin Felben
96988-accept.text:
With the city of Dalaran under siege by their own constructs, this is the perfect opportunity to, let's say, borrow a few samples.

Imagine an army of arcane-powered abominations. The Dark Lady would have no choice but to recognize my alchemical prowess. Maybe even grant me head of the Royal Apothecary Society?

Go to the city and find the constructs' cores. They are unlikely to give them willingly, so do what you must.
96988-accept.title: Source of Power

97003-complete.name: Gur'ak
97003-complete.text:
Impressive, $c. None will doubt my tales when I return to Orgrimmar with this grim proof of the existence of these abominations. Rest assured this glory is yours however, and I will speak loudly of your deeds.

Lok-tar!
97003-complete.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener

97003-progress.name: Gur'ak
97003-progress.text:
It took the strength of six skilled fighters to defeat one of these creatures, and it still managed to fell four of us before we could put it down.

If these monstrous beasts were to appear in greater numbers, the damage that the quilboar could inflict upon the land could be catastrophic.
97003-progress.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener

97538-progress.name: Tah Winterhoof
97538-progress.text:
You have returned! Were you able to find the mirkweed plant pods in Mirkfallon Lake?

We $r have used this plant pigment in our paints for generations, so any amount you manage to bring would be appreciated. Though there are many ways to get a red pigment, I find the mirkweed to give the richest and most vibrant hue of the methods I'm familiar with.
97538-progress.title: Pigments for Paints

97985-accept.name: Calder Gray
97985-accept.text:
Fascinating, aren't they? This is the first time I have ever been privy to the secrets of abomination creation.

I have been studying these notes, and it appears we need a heart. A massive one!

I hear there is a thunder lizard there of impressive size called Stormheart, that patrols along the canyon edge in Thousand Needles. With a name like that it must have the perfect heart. I must have that heart!

Oh, also I suggest you bring friends. Stormheart isn't known for being docile.
97985-accept.title: Thundering Hearts
